observations: A large, heavy-duty mechanical assembly, likely an automotive transmission or gearbox.
The casing is heavily coated in a thick, greyish-brown substance, possibly old grease, oil, or dirt.
The top cover is open, revealing multiple large metal gears and shafts.
A person's hands are visible, manipulating the gears, suggesting it is being worked on or tested.
The background appears to be a workshop or garage environment.

risks.risk: Internal mechanical failure or seized gears
risks.proof: A video showing the gears turning smoothly by hand or a diagnostic test.
A clear photo of the internal components or a video of the unit running.
A photo of the shafts at the bottom and sides of the casing.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Video of the gearbox being turned by hand to check for smooth operation and noise.

response.reason: The item is identifiable as a gearbox from the photos, so it can be priced at its worst case as a non-functional unit.
